<?php
declare(strict_types=1);

namespace core;

/**
 * Error reference and server log (error contract, phase 1).
 * Every response carries a request id (also the X-Request-Id header). Every error response is
 * normalised by normalize() and writes one P2D-ERR line to the server log. Nothing here returns
 * credentials, SQL text or provider bodies to clients; callers pass messages, this class masks them.
 */
final class ErrorContext
{
    private const ALPHABET = 'ABCDEFGHIJKLMNOPQRSTUVWXYZ0123456789';
    public const EXCEPTION_KEY = '_exception';
    /** Marker set by a site whose error body must not get a default error_code (pinned flag-off refusals). */
    public const NO_DEFAULT_CODE_KEY = '_no_default_code';
    public const UNEXPECTED_MESSAGE = 'Something went wrong on the server. Please try again; if it keeps happening, send the reference to IT.';

    /** Test seam only: when set, log lines go here instead of error_log(). */
    public static ?\Closure $sink = null;

    private static ?string $requestId = null;
    private static string $method = '-';
    private static string $route = '-';
    private static ?int $userId = null;
    private static string $role = '-';

    /** One reference per request, generated on first use: R- and 10 upper-case letters or digits. */
    public static function requestId(): string
    {
        if (self::$requestId === null) {
            $id = '';
            for ($i = 0; $i < 10; $i++) {
                $id .= self::ALPHABET[random_int(0, strlen(self::ALPHABET) - 1)];
            }
            self::$requestId = 'R-' . $id;
        }
        return self::$requestId;
    }

    /** Called once by public/index.php with the request method and URI (the query string is dropped). */
    public static function begin(string $method, string $uri): void
    {
        self::$method = substr(preg_replace('/[^A-Z]/', '', strtoupper($method)) ?? '', 0, 10) ?: '-';
        $path = parse_url($uri, PHP_URL_PATH);
        self::$route = is_string($path) && $path !== '' ? self::redact($path, 200) : '-';
    }

    /** Called by requireAuth() once the session has been checked against the database. */
    public static function setUser(?int $userId, ?string $designation): void
    {
        self::$userId = $userId !== null && $userId > 0 ? $userId : null;
        self::$role = self::roleOf((string)$designation) ?: '-';
    }

    public static function role(): string
    {
        return self::$role;
    }

    /** Admin and Super Admin only see provider details (same rule as JourneyPolicy::admin). */
    public static function canSeeProvider(): bool
    {
        return in_array(self::$role, ['admin', 'super_admin'], true);
    }

    /**
     * Makes an error body follow the contract: error and message mirror each other, error_code defaults to
     * HTTP-<status>, request_id is added, and a provider block is kept only for admins. Logs one line.
     * Success bodies (status below 400) are returned unchanged.
     *
     * @param mixed $data
     * @param ?\Throwable $exception logged only, never returned
     * @param ?array $provider provider block (name, http_status, code, message); logged always, returned for admins
     * @return mixed
     */
    public static function normalize($data, int $status, ?\Throwable $exception = null, ?array $provider = null)
    {
        // apiError() passes its exception under this key so it reaches here through jsonResponse(); it is never returned.
        if (is_array($data) && array_key_exists(self::EXCEPTION_KEY, $data)) {
            if ($data[self::EXCEPTION_KEY] instanceof \Throwable) {
                $exception = $data[self::EXCEPTION_KEY];
            }
            unset($data[self::EXCEPTION_KEY]);
        }
        // Flag-off refusals keep their pinned shape: the marker suppresses the default error_code and is never returned.
        $skipDefaultCode = is_array($data) && array_key_exists(self::NO_DEFAULT_CODE_KEY, $data);
        if (is_array($data)) {
            unset($data[self::NO_DEFAULT_CODE_KEY]);
        }
        if ($status < 400) {
            return $data;
        }
        $body = is_array($data) ? $data : [];
        $hasError = isset($body['error']);
        $hasMessage = isset($body['message']);
        if (!$hasError && $hasMessage && is_string($body['message'])) {
            $body['error'] = $body['message'];
        }
        if (!$hasMessage && $hasError && is_string($body['error'])) {
            $body['message'] = $body['error'];
        }
        if (!isset($body['error']) && !isset($body['message'])) {
            $body['error'] = 'The request could not be completed.';
            $body['message'] = 'The request could not be completed. Please try again; if it keeps happening, send the reference to IT.';
        }
        // The text as the site wrote it goes to the log only. A 5xx shows the generic sentence unless the site gave a
        // code of its own (curated), so SQL or provider text never reaches a user.
        $original = is_string($body['message'] ?? null) ? $body['message'] : (is_string($body['error'] ?? null) ? $body['error'] : '-');
        // A site's own code (error_code, or a scalar code such as AFTER_HOURS_*) makes its text curated.
        $siteCode = is_string($body['code'] ?? null) || is_int($body['code'] ?? null) ? (string)$body['code'] : null;
        $curated = isset($body['error_code']) || ($siteCode !== null && $siteCode !== '');
        if ($status >= 500 && !$curated) {
            $body['error'] = self::UNEXPECTED_MESSAGE;
            $body['message'] = self::UNEXPECTED_MESSAGE;
        }
        if (!isset($body['error_code']) && !$skipDefaultCode) {
            // Keep 'code' itself as the site wrote it; error_code carries the same value for clients that read it.
            $body['error_code'] = $siteCode !== null && $siteCode !== '' ? $siteCode : 'HTTP-' . $status;
        }
        if (!isset($body['request_id'])) {
            $body['request_id'] = self::requestId();
        }

        $provider = $provider ?? (isset($body['provider']) && is_array($body['provider']) ? $body['provider'] : null);
        unset($body['provider']);
        if ($provider !== null && self::canSeeProvider()) {
            $body['provider'] = self::providerFields($provider, 300);
        }

        $fields = [
            'http_status' => $status,
            'error_code' => (string)($body['error_code'] ?? '-'),
            'message' => self::redact($original, 500),
        ];
        if ($exception !== null) {
            $fields += self::exceptionFields($exception);
        }
        if ($provider !== null) {
            $fields['provider'] = self::providerFields($provider, 500);
        }
        self::log($fields);
        return $body;
    }

    /**
     * Sends a JSON body through the contract and ends the request. For code that answers before any controller
     * (WAF, rate limit, webhooks). $body may carry EXCEPTION_KEY, which is logged and never sent.
     */
    public static function respond(array $body, int $status): void
    {
        $out = self::normalize($body, $status);
        if (!headers_sent()) {
            http_response_code($status);
            header('Content-Type: application/json; charset=utf-8');
            header('X-Request-Id: ' . self::requestId());
        }
        echo self::encode($out);
        exit();
    }

    /**
     * JSON for a response body. Invalid UTF-8 is substituted; if encoding still fails, a minimal error body is
     * sent instead of an empty one, so the client always gets JSON with the reference.
     */
    public static function encode($body): string
    {
        $json = json_encode($body, JSON_INVALID_UTF8_SUBSTITUTE);
        if ($json !== false) {
            return $json;
        }
        return (string)json_encode([
            'status' => 'error',
            'error' => 'The request could not be completed.',
            'message' => 'The request could not be completed. Please try again; if it keeps happening, send the reference to IT.',
            'error_code' => 'SYS-UNH-01',
            'request_id' => self::requestId(),
        ]);
    }

    /** Body for an uncaught exception or fatal error: JSON 500 with SYS-UNH-01 and the reference. */
    public static function unhandled(\Throwable $e): void
    {
        self::fail(['http_status' => 500, 'error_code' => 'SYS-UNH-01', 'message' => 'Unhandled exception'] + self::exceptionFields($e), true);
    }

    /** Fatal errors caught at shutdown: always logged, JSON sent only if no output has started. */
    public static function fatal(array $error): void
    {
        // Half-written output from the failed request must not reach the client ahead of the JSON body.
        while (ob_get_level() > 0) {
            ob_end_clean();
        }
        $message = is_string($error['message'] ?? null) ? $error['message'] : 'Fatal error';
        self::fail([
            'http_status' => 500,
            'error_code' => 'SYS-UNH-01',
            'exception' => 'FatalError',
            'message' => 'Fatal error',
            'exception_message' => self::redact($message, 500),
            'file' => self::relativeFile((string)($error['file'] ?? '-')) . ':' . (int)($error['line'] ?? 0),
        ], false);
    }

    /** Converts an exception into log fields: class, redacted exception_message, SQLSTATE and file:line. */
    public static function exceptionFields(\Throwable $e): array
    {
        // Never the message: database and provider text can name users, hosts or data. Class, SQLSTATE, errno and place only.
        $fields = [
            'exception' => get_class($e),
            'file' => self::relativeFile($e->getFile()) . ':' . $e->getLine(),
        ];
        if ($e instanceof \PDOException) {
            $state = $e->errorInfo[0] ?? $e->getCode();
            $fields['sql_state'] = is_string($state) && $state !== '' ? $state : '-';
            $fields['errno'] = is_int($e->errorInfo[1] ?? null) ? $e->errorInfo[1] : null;
        }
        return $fields;
    }

    /** Provider block for a response (max $max characters) or for the log. */
    public static function providerFields(array $provider, int $max): array
    {
        $code = $provider['code'] ?? null;
        $status = $provider['http_status'] ?? null;
        return [
            'name' => self::redact((string)($provider['name'] ?? '-'), 60),
            'http_status' => is_int($status) ? $status : null,
            'code' => $code === null ? null : self::redact((string)$code, 60),
            'message' => self::redact((string)($provider['message'] ?? ''), $max),
        ];
    }

    /**
     * Masks secrets and personal data for logs and short client messages: Bearer tokens, JWTs, key/password
     * assignments, e-mail addresses (j***@domain) and digit runs of seven or more (phone, card: keep last 3).
     * Control characters become spaces. The result is cut to $max characters.
     */
    public static function redact(string $text, int $max = 300): string
    {
        $text = preg_replace('/Bearer\s+[A-Za-z0-9._~+\/=-]+/i', 'Bearer [redacted]', $text) ?? '[redacted]';
        $text = preg_replace('/\b[A-Za-z0-9_-]{10,}\.[A-Za-z0-9_-]{10,}\.[A-Za-z0-9_-]{10,}\b/', '[jwt]', $text) ?? '[redacted]';
        $text = preg_replace(
            '/((?:password|passwd|pwd|secret|token|api[_-]?key|apikey|authorization|access[_-]?key)["\']?\s*[:=]\s*["\']?)[^\s"\',;&]+/i',
            '$1[redacted]',
            $text
        ) ?? '[redacted]';
        $text = preg_replace_callback(
            '/([A-Za-z0-9._%+-]+)@([A-Za-z0-9.-]+\.[A-Za-z]{2,})/',
            static fn (array $m): string => substr($m[1], 0, 1) . '***@' . $m[2],
            $text
        ) ?? '[redacted]';
        $text = preg_replace_callback(
            '/\+?\d(?:[\s().-]?\d){6,}/',
            static fn (array $m): string => '***' . substr((string)preg_replace('/\D/', '', $m[0]), -3),
            $text
        ) ?? '[redacted]';
        $text = preg_replace('/[\x00-\x1f\x7f]/', ' ', $text) ?? '';
        return strlen($text) > $max ? self::cutUtf8($text, $max) . '...' : $text;
    }

    /** Writes one `P2D-ERR {json}` line. Never throws: logging must not change the response. */
    public static function log(array $fields): void
    {
        try {
            $line = array_merge([
                'request_id' => self::requestId(),
                'at' => gmdate('Y-m-d\TH:i:s\Z'),
                'method' => self::$method,
                'route' => self::$route,
                'user_id' => self::$userId,
                'role' => self::$role,
            ], $fields);
            $json = json_encode($line, JSON_UNESCAPED_SLASHES | JSON_UNESCAPED_UNICODE | JSON_INVALID_UTF8_SUBSTITUTE | JSON_PARTIAL_OUTPUT_ON_ERROR);
            $text = 'P2D-ERR ' . ($json === false ? '{}' : $json);
            if (self::$sink !== null) {
                (self::$sink)($text);
            } else {
                error_log($text);
            }
        } catch (\Throwable $ignored) {
            // Logging failure is never shown to the client.
        }
    }

    /** Test seam only: forget request state so a test can start a new request. */
    public static function reset(): void
    {
        self::$requestId = null;
        self::$method = '-';
        self::$route = '-';
        self::$userId = null;
        self::$role = '-';
    }

    /**
     * Writes the unhandled-error line and the JSON 500 body. The body is written even when headers are already
     * out (the exception handler); a shutdown fatal writes it only when nothing has been sent yet.
     */
    private static function fail(array $fields, bool $always): void
    {
        self::log($fields);
        if (!$always && headers_sent()) {
            return;
        }
        if (!headers_sent()) {
            http_response_code(500);
            header('Content-Type: application/json; charset=utf-8');
            header('X-Request-Id: ' . self::requestId());
        }
        echo self::encode([
            'status' => 'error',
            'error' => 'Unexpected server error',
            'message' => self::UNEXPECTED_MESSAGE,
            'error_code' => 'SYS-UNH-01',
            'request_id' => self::requestId(),
        ]);
    }

    /** Cuts to at most $max bytes without splitting a multibyte character (no mbstring needed). */
    private static function cutUtf8(string $text, int $max): string
    {
        $cut = substr($text, 0, $max);
        $i = strlen($cut) - 1;
        while ($i >= 0 && (ord($cut[$i]) & 0xC0) === 0x80) {
            $i--;
        }
        if ($i >= 0) {
            $lead = ord($cut[$i]);
            $need = $lead >= 0xF0 ? 4 : ($lead >= 0xE0 ? 3 : ($lead >= 0xC0 ? 2 : 1));
            if (strlen($cut) - $i < $need) {
                $cut = substr($cut, 0, $i);
            }
        }
        return $cut;
    }

    private static function roleOf(string $designation): string
    {
        return str_replace([' ', '-'], '_', strtolower(trim($designation)));
    }

    private static function relativeFile(string $file): string
    {
        $file = str_replace('\\', '/', $file);
        if (defined('ROOT_PATH')) {
            $root = rtrim(str_replace('\\', '/', (string)ROOT_PATH), '/') . '/';
            if (str_starts_with($file, $root)) {
                return substr($file, strlen($root));
            }
        }
        return basename($file);
    }
}
